specimens.title: Quiet centre
specimens.feedback:
Okay, this is really good. I just love to come up with different variants of this specific one, like:
- Positioning of elements: where do the m-wings go? Why not put the m-wings above it?
- Removing the O1 AI operating system, or maybe having an operating system somewhere else.
- I don't know about the O1 part and the /.
- Potentially different types of buttons on it as well.
- Different sizing of the m-wings, like the kind of variations I want to say of this.
- Thinking of whether there are different variations where you could maybe add more elements or change something as well, or different sizing, like showing this as vertically oriented or horizontally oriented.

specimens.title: Horizontal launch
specimens.feedback: This is really good and the dark variant is liked. Build variants with Wings centred and larger as well as top-right. Remove the product number.

specimens.feedback: Rethink the capsule because the pill does not currently contain meaningful information. Rebuild how the capsule is used.

specimens.title: Minimal edition
specimens.feedback: The layout and layering need significant refinement. Remove the internal MZ-G13 label and the top-left edition number because neither is relevant to the customer.

specimens.title: Archive keyline
specimens.feedback: The layout and layering need significant refinement. Remove the internal gradient ID and the top-left edition number.

specimens.title: Founder frame
specimens.feedback: Remove internal gradient IDs and decorative numbers. Keep exploring the dark background but rethink the Founder colour and finish treatment.

specimens.title: Side spine
specimens.feedback: This is cool. Test it horizontally with a middle spine or band and different text. Remove the internal MZ-G20 label and top-left number.

specimens.title: Offset stack
specimens.feedback: Test squared bottom-left and bottom-right corners so the media blends into the footer. Build centred and top-right Wings versions, plus other bounded placements. Test a dark footer and more useful footer copy.

specimens.title: Fan deck
specimens.feedback: Test squared bottom-left and bottom-right corners so the media blends into the footer. Build centred and top-right Wings versions, plus other bounded placements. Test a dark footer and more useful footer copy.

specimens.title: Product explainer
specimens.feedback: Remove the sphere/circle. Place the Wings directly on the Living Core background.

specimens.title: Bundle offer
specimens.feedback: This is really good and is one of the strongest designs in the round.

agentInterpretation.roundSignal: Round 07 is the strongest round so far and establishes the correct underlying language. The next round is refinement and controlled variation, not another conceptual reset.
